readings.title: Moses Commissions Joshua
readings.subtitle: The Denial of Moses' Entry
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 3:21] “And <dn>I</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes have seen <dn>את</dn> all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has done to these two sovereigns. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does the same to all the reigns which you are passing over. [22] Do not fear <dn>את</dn> them, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> <dn>Himself</dn> fights for you.’ [23] “And <dn>I</dn> pleaded with <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at that time, saying, [24] O Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have begun to show <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> servant <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> greatness and <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> strong hand, for who is a mighty one in the heavens or on earth who does according to <dn>Your</dn> works and according to <dn>Your</dn> might? [25] <dn>I</dn> pray, let me pass over and see <dn>את</dn> the good land beyond the Yarděn, this good hill country, and Leḇanon.’ [26] “But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was enraged with me, for your sake, and would not listen to me, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Enough of that! Speak no more to <dn>Me</dn> about this matter.</dq> [27] <dq>Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and look with your eyes, for you do not pass over <dn>את</dn> this Yarděn.</dq> [28] <dq>But command <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua, and strengthen him and make him brave, for he shall pass over before this people and cause them to inherit <dn>את</dn> the land which you see.’</dq> [29] “And we dwelt in the valley opposite Běyth Pe‛or.

readings.title: Guarding the Torah
readings.subtitle: The Wisdom of Israel
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 4:1] “And now, O Yisra’ěl, listen to the laws and the right-rulings which <dn>I</dn> am teaching <dn>את</dn> you to do, so that you live, and shall go in and possess <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of your fathers is giving you. [2] “Do not add to the Word which <dn>I</dn> command <dn>את</dn> you, and do not take away from it, so as to guard <dn>את</dn> the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> which <dn>I</dn> am commanding <dn>את</dn> you. [3] “Your eyes have seen <dn>את</dn> what <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> did at Ba‛al Pe‛or, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has destroyed from your midst <dn>את</dn> all the men who followed Ba‛al Pe‛or. [4] “But you who are clinging to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> are alive today, every one of you. [5] “See, <dn>I</dn> have taught <dn>את</dn> you laws and right-rulings, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> commanded me, to do thus in the land which you go to possess. [6] “And you shall guard and do them, for this is your wisdom and your understanding before the eyes of the peoples who hear <dn>את</dn> all these laws, and they shall say, ‘Only a wise and understanding people is this great nation!’ [7] “For what great nation is there which has <dn>Elohim</dn> so near to it, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> is to us, whenever we call on <dn>Him</dn>? [8] “And what great nation is there that has such laws and righteous right-rulings like all this Torah which <dn>I</dn> set before you this day? [9] “Only, guard yourself, and guard your life diligently, lest you forget <dn>את</dn> the Words your eyes have seen, and lest they turn aside from your heart all the days of your life. And you shall make them known to your children and your grandchildren. [10] “The day when you stood before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> in Ḥorěḇ, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘Assemble the people to <dn>Me</dn> and <dn>I</dn> make them hear <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Words, so that they learn to fear <dn>את</dn> <dn>Me</dn> all the days they live on the earth and teach them to their children.’</dq> [11] “And you came near and stood at the foot of the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire to the heart of the heavens – darkness, cloud, and thick darkness. [12] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to you out of the midst of the fire. You heard a voice of words, but saw no form, you only heard a voice. [13] “And <dn>He</dn> made known to you <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> covenant which <dn>He</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> you to do, the Ten Words, and <dn>He</dn> wrote them on two tablets of stone. [14] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded me at that time to teach <dn>את</dn> you laws and right-rulings, for you to do them in the land which you pass over to possess.

readings.title: The Danger of Carved Images
readings.subtitle: The Jealousy and Compassion of Elohim
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 4:15] “Therefore, diligently guard yourselves, for you saw no form when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to you at Ḥorěḇ out of the midst of the fire, [16] lest you should do corruptly and shall make for yourselves a carved image in the form of any figure – the likeness of male or female, [17] the likeness of any beast that is on the earth or the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the heavens, [18] the likeness of any creature that creeps on the ground or the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth; [19] and lest you lift up your eyes to the heavens, and shall see <dn>את</dn> the sun, and <dn>את</dn> the moon, and <dn>את</dn> the stars – all the host of the heavens – and you be drawn away into bowing down to them and serving them, which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has allotted to all the peoples under all the heavens. [20] “But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has taken <dn>את</dn> you and brought <dn>את</dn> you out of the iron furnace, out of Mitsrayim, to be <dn>His</dn> people, an inheritance, as it is today. [21] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was enraged with me because of your words, and swore that <dn>I</dn> would not pass over <dn>את</dn> the Yarděn, and that <dn>I</dn> would not enter the good land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you as an inheritance. [22] “For <dn>I</dn> am to die in this land, <dn>I</dn> am not passing over <dn>את</dn> the Yarděn, but you are passing over, and shall possess <dn>את</dn> that good land. [23] “Guard yourselves, lest you forget <dn>את</dn> the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> which <dn>He</dn> made with you, and shall make for yourselves a carved image in any form, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has commanded you. [24] “For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is a consuming fire, a jealous <dn>Ěl</dn>. [25] “When you bring forth children and grandchildren, and shall grow old in the land, and shall do corruptly and make a carved image in the form of whatever, and shall do what is evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> to provoke <dn>Him</dn>, [26] “<dn>I</dn> shall call <dn>את</dn> the heavens and <dn>את</dn> earth to witness against you on that day, that you soon completely perish from the land which you pass over <dn>את</dn> the Yarděn to possess – you do not prolong your days in it but are completely destroyed. [27] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall scatter <dn>את</dn> you among the peoples, and you shall be left few in number among the nations where <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> drives <dn>את</dn> you. [28] “And there you shall serve mighty ones, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell. [29] “But from there you shall seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and shall find, when you search for <dn>Him</dn> with all your heart and with all your being. [30] “In your distress, when all these words shall come upon you in the latter days, then you shall return to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> and shall obey <dn>His</dn> voice. [31] “For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is a compassionate <dn>Ěl</dn>, <dn>He</dn> does not forsake you, nor destroy you, nor forget <dn>את</dn> the covenant of your fathers which <dn>He</dn> swore to them.

readings.title: The Greatness of the Revelation
readings.subtitle: There is None Else
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 4:32] “For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that <dn>Elohim</dn> created man on the earth, and ask from one end of the heavens to the other end of the heavens, whether there has been a Word as great as this, or has been heard like it. [33] “Has a people heard the voice of <dn>Elohim</dn> speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and live? [34] “Or has <dn>Elohim</dn> tried to go and take for <dn>Himself</dn> a nation from the midst of a nation by trials, and by signs, and by wonders, and by battle, and by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great fearsome deeds, according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> did for you in Mitsrayim before your eyes? [35] “You have been shown it, to know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Himself</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn>; there is no one beside <dn>Him</dn>. [36] “From the heavens <dn>He</dn> let you hear <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> voice, to instruct you, and on earth <dn>He</dn> showed you <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> great fire, and you heard <dn>His</dn> words out of the midst of the fire. [37] “And because <dn>He</dn> loved <dn>את</dn> your fathers, therefore <dn>He</dn> chose their seed after them, and brought you out of Mitsrayim with <dn>His</dn> Presence, with <dn>His</dn> great power, [38] to drive out from before you nations greater and stronger than you, to bring you in, to give you <dn>את</dn> their land as an inheritance, as it is today. [39] “And you shall know today, and shall recall to your heart that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Himself</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn> in the heavens above and on the earth beneath; there is none else. [40] “And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> laws and <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> commands which <dn>I</dn> command you today, so that it is well with you and with your children after you, and so that you prolong your days on the soil which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you for all time.”

readings.title: Three Cities Beyond the Jordan
readings.subtitle: Asylum for the Manslayer
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 4:41] Then Mosheh separated three cities beyond the Yarděn, toward the rising of the sun, [42] for a man-slayer to flee there, he who unknowingly murdered <dn>את</dn> his neighbour, without having hated him in time past, and might flee to one of these cities and live: [43] <dn>את</dn> Betser in the wilderness in the level land for the Re’uḇěnites, and <dn>את</dn> Ramoth in Gil‛aḏ for the Gaḏites, and <dn>את</dn> Golan in Bashan for the Menashshites.

readings.title: The Proclamation of the Law
readings.subtitle: The Conquests Recounted
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 4:44] And this is the Torah which Mosheh set before the children of Yisra’ěl. [45] These are the witnesses, and the laws, and the right-rulings which Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ěl after they came out of Mitsrayim, [46] beyond the Yarděn, in the valley opposite Běyth Pe‛or, in the land of Siḥon sovereign of the Amorites, who dwelt at Ḥeshbon, whom Mosheh and the children of Yisra’ěl had stricken after they came out of Mitsrayim. [47] And they took possession of <dn>את</dn> his land and <dn>את</dn> the land of Oḡ sovereign of Bashan, two sovereigns of the Amorites, who were beyond the Yarděn, toward the rising of the sun, [48] from Aro‛ěr, which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, even to Mount Siyon, which is Ḥermon, [49] and all the desert plain beyond the Yarděn as far as the Sea of the Araḇah, below the slopes of Pisgah.

readings.title: The Covenant at Horeb
readings.subtitle: The Foundation of the Torah
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 5:1] And Mosheh called all Yisra’ěl, and said to them, “Hear, O Yisra’ěl, <dn>את</dn> the laws and <dn>את</dn> right-rulings which <dn>I</dn> speak in your hearing today. And you shall learn <dn>את</dn> them, and guard to do them. [2] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> made a covenant with us in Ḥorěḇ. [3] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> did not make <dn>את</dn> this covenant with <dn>את</dn> our fathers, but with <dn>את</dn> us, those who are here today, all of us who are alive. [4] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke with you face to face on the mountain from the midst of the fire. [5] “<dn>I</dn> stood between <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and you at that time, to declare to you <dn>את</dn> the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – for you were afraid because of the fire, and you did not go up the mountain – saying: [6] <dq><dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> who brought you out of the land of Mitsrayim, out of the house of bondage.</dq> [7] <dq>You have no other mighty ones against <dn>My</dn> face.</dq> [8] <dq>You do not make for yourself a carved image, any likeness of which is in the heavens above, or which is in the earth beneath, or which is in the waters under the earth,</dq> [9] <dq>you do not bow down to them nor serve them. For <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, am a jealous <dn>Ěl</dn>, visiting the crookedness of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate <dn>Me</dn>,</dq> [10] <dq>but showing loving-commitment to thousands, to those who love <dn>Me</dn> and guard <dn>My</dn> commands.</dq> [11] <dq>You do not bring <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> to naught, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does not leave him unpunished <dn>את</dn> who brings <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> Name to naught.</dq> [12] <dq>Guard <dn>את</dn> the Sabbath day, to set it apart, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> commanded you.</dq> [13] <dq>Six days you labour, and shall do all your work,</dq> [14] <dq>but the seventh day is a Sabbath of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>. You do not do any work – you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger who is within your gates, so that your male servant and your female servant rest as you do.</dq> [15] <dq>And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Mitsrayim, and that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> brought you out from there by a strong hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> commanded you to perform <dn>את</dn> the Sabbath day.</dq> [16] <dq>Respect <dn>את</dn> your father and <dn>את</dn> your mother, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has commanded you, so that your days are prolonged, and so that it is well with you on the soil which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you.</dq> [17] <dq>You do not murder.</dq> [18] <dq>You do not commit adultery.</dq> [19] <dq>You do not steal.</dq> [20] <dq>You do not bear false witness against your neighbour.</dq> [21] <dq>You do not covet your neighbour’s wife, nor do you desire your neighbour’s house, his field, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, his ox, nor his donkey, or whatever belongs to your neighbour.’</dq> [22] “<dn>את</dn> These Words <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to all your assembly, in the mountain from the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a loud voice, and <dn>He</dn> added no more. And <dn>He</dn> wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me. [23] “And it came to be, when you heard <dn>את</dn> the voice from the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, that you came near to me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders, [24] and said, ‘See, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> has shown us <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> esteem and <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> greatness, and we have heard <dn>His</dn> voice from the midst of the fire. Today we have seen that <dn>Elohim</dn> speaks with <dn>את</dn> man – and he lives! [25] And now why should we die? For this great fire is consuming us. If we hear <dn>את</dn> the voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> any more, then we shall die. [26] For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living <dn>Elohim</dn> speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and does live? [27] You go near and hear <dn>את</dn> all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> says, and speak to us <dn>את</dn> all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> says to you, and we shall hear and do it.’ [28] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> heard <dn>את</dn> the voice of your words when you spoke to me, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>‘<dn>I</dn> have heard <dn>את</dn> the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.</dq> [29] <dq>Oh, that they had such a heart in them, to fear <dn>את</dn> <dn>Me</dn> and to guard <dn>את</dn> all <dn>My</dn> commands always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever!</dq> [30] <dq>Go, say to them, “Return to your tents.”</dq> [31] <dq>But you, stand here by <dn>Me</dn>, and let <dn>Me</dn> speak to you <dn>את</dn> all the commands, and the laws, and the right-rulings which you are to teach them. And they shall do them in the land which <dn>I</dn> am giving them to possess.’</dq> [32] “And you shall guard to do as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has commanded you – do not turn aside, to the right or to the left. [33] “Walk in all the ways which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> has commanded you, so that you live and it be well with you. And you shall prolong your days in the land which you possess.
